text:
megan_cs: Quick heads-up - drafting a one-pager customer runbook for low-touch onboarding: cache priming, batching, streaming fallbacks, and a tiny config example to send customers.
raj_eng: include a perf budget (tokens/ms and cost targets) so CS knows when to recommend Dedicated.
megan_cs: will add a 3-tier recommendation: starter (free), steady (pay-as-you-go), high-throughput (dedicated). renewal signal = daily error spike >5%.
lia_engineer: caching guidance: TTL tiers => ephemeral 30s, session 5m, profile 24h. prefilling <=512 tokens for predictable latency.
sam_ops: add a warmup job snippet customers can run pre-launch to populate prefix cache; keep it SDK-agnostic.
kelsey_cs: recommended Redwood Console hooks: prefix_hit_rate, avg_latency_p95, tokens_per_second. suggest alert thresholds too.
raj_eng: small warmup example: for i in 1..50; POST /v1/generate with short prompt, sleep 0.5s. good enough to populate KV prefix.
lia_engineer: graceful-degradation matrix: primary=streaming; fallback=non-streaming short context; last-resort=smaller quantized model. note expected latency deltas (+50-200ms).
megan_cs: FAQ blurb for renewals: recommend Dedicated when sustained p95 >200ms or >1M tokens/day with cost concerns.
sam_ops: add AE->engops handoff template with account_id, predicted_qps, go-live window, enablement link.
kelsey_cs: I'll draft a 3-question feedback capture (NPS + 2 open prompts) to attach to go-live checklist.
prefill-bot: reminder set - publish draft to /docs/cs-playbooks/ by EOD tomorrow unless objections. :bell:
megan_cs: thanks all. I'll post the assembled one-pager here before noon. if anyone wants to drop a tiny TTL/batching JSON snippet, paste it now. :thumbsup:
